title: Beyond Hash Matching: AI-Based Detection of Previously Unidentified CSAM and its Legal Implications in the EU
summary: The original age-labeled valid-image audit quantifies an applied adolescent failure sharply masked by aggregate accuracy. The service comparison, legal analysis and image content outside this age-only arm are unrepresented. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
